title: CUT&RUN with Drosophila tissues
author: Kami Ahmad
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.umfeu3n

steps.title: Prepare 5% Digitonin Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a fresh 5% digitonin solution.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 50 mg digitonin powder into a 2 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Warm a 1000 μL pipette tip by pipetting in and out of boiled water.
Add hot water to the tube with digitonin powder, cap, and vortex on full until completely dissolved.
Note: If refrigerated, reheat before use; stock is stable for one week.

steps.title: Prepare Wash+ Buffer (50 mL)
steps.instruction: Prepare 50 mL of Wash+ Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 mL of wash buffer stock solution to a 50 mL conical tube.
Add 1 large Roche complete EDTA-free tablet.
Add 125 µL 200 mM Spermidine (final concentration 0.5 mM).
Store on ice or overnight at 4°C.

steps.title: Prepare Dig-Block-EDTA (dbe+) Buffer (25 mL)
steps.instruction: Prepare 25 mL of dbe+ Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 mL of Wash+ Buffer to a 50 mL conical tube.
Add 100 µL 0.5 M EDTA (final concentration 2 mM).
Add 250 µL 5% Digitonin (final concentration 0.05%).
Store on ice or overnight at 4°C.

steps.title: Prepare ConA Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare Concanavalin A-coated beads.

substeps.instruction: Gently vortex the Bio-Mag Plus Concanavalin A-coated beads bottle.
Transfer 150 µL of bead slurry to an eppendorf.
Bind beads with a magnet for 5 minutes, remove buffer, and replace with 1 mL Binding buffer.
Incubate for 1 minute.
Wash 2X.
Resuspend ConA beads in 150 µL of Binding buffer.

steps.title: Collect and Dissect Wing Discs
steps.instruction: Collect and dissect 3rd instar larvae using a dissecting microscope with tangential illumination.

substeps.instruction: Collect healthy 3rd instar larvae in a glass dish with PBT and wash off yeast and food.
Aliquot 200 µL Wash+ buffer into 2 wells of a clean shallow dissection dish per sample.
Transfer larvae to the dish and dissect out 10 wing discs (complete within 10 minutes).
Transfer wing discs to the second well of Wash+ buffer using a 200 µL pipette tip.

steps.title: Bind Tissues to Beads
steps.instruction: Bind the dissected wing discs to ConA beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 15 µL ConA bead suspension to an eppendorf.
Transfer wing discs and a minimal volume of Wash+ buffer to the eppendorf.
Mix by gentle pipetting and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: Block Tissues
steps.instruction: Block the tissues to prevent non-specific binding.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL dbe+ buffer to each eppendorf.
Gently flick to mix and incubate for 10 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate samples with primary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Prepare antibody dilutions in dbe+ buffer (typically 1:100; e.g., 10 µL antibody in 1 mL dbe+ buffer for 10 reactions, or 1 µL antibody in 100 µL dbe+ buffer per sample).
Place eppendorfs on magnet for 2 minutes to bind beads.
Remove buffer and replace with 100 µL antibody dilution.
Incubate at a 60° angle on an orbital shaker, orbiting slowly, at 4°C overnight.

steps.title: Wash Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the beads after primary antibody incubation.

substeps.instruction: Briefly spin tubes to collect liquid.
Place tubes on magnet for 2 minutes to grab beads.
Remove buffer and replace with 500 µL dbe+ buffer.
Resuspend by pipetting and incubate for 2 minutes at RT.
Repeat this wash process one more time.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Incubation (Optional)
steps.instruction: Adapt mouse IgG primary antibody for protein-A binding using a secondary antibody (skip if not needed).

substeps.instruction: Prepare secondary rabbit anti-mouse IgG antibody dilution in dbe+ buffer (1:100; e.g., 10 µL antibody in 1 mL dbe+ buffer for 10 reactions).
Place eppendorfs on magnet for 2 minutes.
Remove buffer and replace with 100 µL secondary antibody dilution.
Incubate at a 60° angle on an orbital shaker, orbiting slowly, for 1 hour at RT.

steps.title: Wash Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the beads after secondary antibody incubation.

substeps.instruction: Briefly spin tubes to collect liquid.
Place tubes on magnet for 2 minutes to grab beads.
Remove buffer and replace with 500 µL dbe+ buffer.
Resuspend by pipetting and incubate for 2 minutes at RT.
Repeat this wash process one more time.

steps.title: pAMN Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate samples with pAMN.

substeps.instruction: Prepare pAMN dilution in dbe+ buffer (e.g., for Batch #6 at 1:400, add 2.5 µL pAMN#6 to 1 mL dbe+ buffer for 10 samples).
Place tubes on magnet for 2 minutes.
Remove buffer and replace with 100 µL pAMN dilution.
Resuspend by pipetting and incubate while orbiting slowly for 1 hour at RT.

steps.title: Wash pAMN
steps.instruction: Wash the beads after pAMN incubation.

substeps.instruction: Briefly spin tubes to collect liquid.
Place samples on magnet for 2 minutes to grab beads.
Remove buffer and replace with 500 µL Wash+ buffer.
Resuspend by pipetting and incubate for 2 minutes.
Repeat this wash process one more time.

steps.title: Prepare Wash+C Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare Wash+C buffer for cleavage.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 1.5 mL Wash+ buffer and add 30 µL 100 mM CaCl2 (final concentration 2 mM CaCl2).
Mix and chill on ice.

steps.title: Cleavage Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform the chromatin cleavage reaction.

substeps.instruction: Place sample tubes on magnet for 2 minutes to grab beads.
Remove buffer and place samples on ice to chill tubes.
Promptly resuspend sample with 150 µL Wash+C buffer.
Incubate for 30 minutes on ice, occasionally flicking the tube to resuspend beads.

steps.title: Prepare Stop and Pellet Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare buffers for stopping the reaction and pellet processing.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 2XSTOPyR buffer: Aliquot 1600 µL 2XSTOP buffer, add 3.2 µL 1 ng/mL yeast spike-in DNA and 10 µL RNaseA; chill on ice.
Prepare Pellet buffer: Aliquot 800 µL Wash+ buffer, add 800 µL 2XSTOP buffer, 3.2 µL 1 ng/mL yeast spike-in DNA, 17 µL 10% SDS, and 22 µL 20mg/mL proteinase K; store at RT.

steps.title: Stop Cleavage and Digest
steps.instruction: Stop the cleavage reaction and digest proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add 150 µL 2XSTOPyR buffer to each sample tube and pipette to mix.
Incubate samples in a 37°C water bath for 30 minutes.
Add 2 µL 10% SDS and 2.5 µL 20 mg/mL Proteinase K to each 'S' (supernatant) sample and mix by brief vortexing.
Incubate both 'S' and 'P' (pellet) samples in a 50°C water bath for 2 hours.

steps.title: DNA Recovery from Supernatant (S)
steps.instruction: Recover DNA from the supernatant fraction.

substeps.instruction: Use wide-bore green tips to add 40 µL AmpureXP bead slurry and 560 µL MXP buffer to 'S' tubes (2V PEG:sample ratio, total volume ~900 µL).
Mix thoroughly by 10X pipetting and incubate for 15 minutes at RT.

steps.title: DNA Recovery from Pellet (P)
steps.instruction: Recover DNA from the pellet fraction.

substeps.instruction: Grab ConA beads with magnet for 2 minutes and transfer supernatant to a new tube.
Use wide-bore green tips to add 40 µL AmpureXP bead slurry and 65 µL HXP buffer to the beads (0.7V PEG:sample ratio, total volume ~255 µL).
Mix thoroughly by 10X pipetting and incubate for 15 minutes at RT.
Grab Ampure beads with magnet for 5 minutes and transfer the supernatant to a new tube labeled 'sample#PX'.
Add 40 µL AmpureXP bead slurry and 155 µL MXP buffer to the beads (2V PEG:sample ratio, total volume ~450 µL).
Mix thoroughly by 10X pipetting and incubate for 15 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Purify Recovered DNA
steps.instruction: Purify DNA from 'S' and 'PX' tubes.

substeps.instruction: Grab Ampure beads with magnet for 5 minutes.
Pipette off buffer without removing beads.
Add 1 mL 80% ethanol to each tube and incubate for 30 seconds.
Aspirate ethanol and replace with 1 mL 80% ethanol; incubate for 30 seconds.
Slowly aspirate all traces of ethanol and air-dry beads for 15 minutes.
Resuspend beads in 40 µL 10 mM Tris pH8.

steps.title: Chromatin Fractionation
steps.instruction: Separate cleaved chromatin particles and pellet.

substeps.instruction: Grab beads on magnet for 2 minutes.
Transfer supernatant containing cleaved chromatin to a new tube marked 'sample#S'.
Resuspend pellet in 150 µL Pellet buffer and label as 'P'.

steps.title: Quality Control and Quantification
steps.instruction: Analyze DNA size distribution and quantify yield.

substeps.instruction: Determine size distribution using Agilent 4200 TapeStation analysis.
Quantify library yield using a dsDNA-specific assay, such as Qubit.
